title: Seeing What Should Be Heard: Diagnosing and Repairing Cross-Modal Shortcuts in Omni-Modal LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.36798v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Omni-modal large language models (LLMs) are expected to answer a question using the modality it explicitly refers to. However, existing training paradigms rarely verify whether models actually follow this modality, because multimodal inputs from the same sample often provide redundant evidence for the same answer. In this work, we uncover a pervasive cross-modal shortcut in omni-modal LLMs: when asked an audio-related question, models rely on the image as much as on the audio, and sometimes even more. To systematically diagnose this behavior, we introduce the Factorized Modality Diagnostic, which independently swaps audio and images between samples to isolate each modality's causal contribution. Across two model families in different settings, we find that this shortcut persists throughout supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning post-training, while judge-based RL may further amplify such reliance on irrelevant visual informa

translated_title: 看见本应听见的：诊断与修复全模态大语言模型中的跨模态捷径
translated_abstract: 全模态大语言模型（LLM）被期望能够使用问题明确指向的模态来回答问题。然而，现有的训练范式很少验证模型是否真的遵循了该模态，因为来自同一样本的多模态输入往往为同一答案提供冗余的证据。在这项工作中，我们揭示了全模态大语言模型中普遍存在的跨模态捷径现象：当被问及与音频相关的问题时，模型对图像的依赖程度与对音频相当，有时甚至更高。为了系统地诊断这种行为，我们引入了因子化模态诊断方法，该方法在样本之间独立地交换音频和图像，以隔离每种模态的因果贡献。在两个模型家族的不同设置中，我们发现这种捷径在监督微调和强化学习后训练过程中持续存在，而基于裁判的强化学习可能会进一步放大这种对无关视觉信息的依赖。
tldr: 该研究揭示了全模态大语言模型在回答音频相关问题时过度依赖图像的跨模态捷径，提出因子化模态诊断方法以隔离各模态的因果贡献，并发现该捷径在监督微调和强化学习后训练中持续存在甚至被放大。
en_tdlr: This study uncovers a pervasive cross-modal shortcut in omni-modal LLMs where models rely on images when answering audio-related questions, introduces the Factorized Modality Diagnostic to isolate each modality's causal contribution, and finds this shortcut persists through SFT and RL post-training, with judge-based RL potentially amplifying such reliance.
